unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Registered account-transfer operation family and outcome-specific inputs
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The v2 operation registry has no actions or closed accepted, no_change, and sparse rejected inputs for manual transfer creation, transfer-source intake, candidate confirmation, mirror-evidence merge, incomplete one-sided intake, or their retries.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register the RG-03 one-to-one same-currency account-transfer operation family with strict accepted/no_change inputs, closed sparse rejected attempted input, correct operation classes, and explicit returned identities; keep combination transfer outside the v1 executable contract.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Reusing manual_expense or confirm_real_transfer would misstate transfer direction, confirmation provenance, and intake semantics; open payloads would weaken atomic rejection and idempotency checks.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Closed transfer source and candidate payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The v2 source registry accepts only explicit balance observations and the candidate registry accepts only balance-adjustment candidates, so complete and incomplete transfer intake cannot be serialized without losing its proposed accounts, amounts, completeness, provenance, or confirmation requirements.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed transfer source and account-transfer candidate payloads for the frozen one-to-one fields, source references, deterministic rule provenance, confidence, pending/confirmed status history, and missing-destination confirmation requirement.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Collapsing source facts into a formal transaction would violate explicit confirmation; collapsing incomplete intake into a complete candidate would authorize guessed destinations or hidden balancing entries.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Transfer evidence subtype
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The v2 evidence union has no subtype for the transfer debit and credit evidence objects; current evidence-link targets, roles, and posting-reconciliation records are already sufficient.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register only a closed transfer-record evidence subtype carrying its source identity and observed_at fact; reuse current evidence_links target_kind, target_id, and role fields and current posting_reconciliations without adding aliases.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Dropping the evidence object loses provenance, while adding duplicate evidence-link or reconciliation fields would create conflicting owners for the same target and match status.
